title: Make upgrades fail-safe with a pre-flight check and automatic rollback
problem: DEMO: after upgrading, the service sometimes fails to start and customers can't find the supported upgrade path from older versions.
evidence: DEMO: illustrative only. In a real run this states the ticket count, median resolution and messages per ticket.
recommendation: Verify the service starts after install and roll back automatically if it doesn't.
Show the required upgrade path in-product and on the download page.

title: Replace generic SSO and API errors with specific, actionable messages
problem: DEMO: SSO login loops and 401 API errors give no hint about the cause.
recommendation: Name the missing permission or expired secret in the error.
Warn admins before SSO secrets expire.
